answer: Require each identity to present receipts from operator-independent resources: a distinct ASN, a distinct payment instrument, a distinct provider-side account. Gate admission on Shannon entropy H = -sum p_i log2 p_i over those classes, with no single class above 20%. Keys are free to copy, resource diversity is not: the Nth identity costs as much as the first, so a farm buys five of each, not one bundle. Every swimmer must carry its own nectar across the ocean; a single shared whisper collapses the whole entropy to zero.
